payload.title: File:Talentichthys kuragh (holotype, ANU V3736).jpg
payload.credit_html: "A new Devonian lungfish from the western Karakoram of northern Pakistan"
payload.description_html: ANU V3736, holotype of Talentichthys kurag, the anterior portion of a lungfish skull preserved in calcareous matrix. (A) Dorsal view. (B) Ventral view. (C) Anterior view. ioc, infraorbital sensory canal; ri, dentine ridge; ?ri, broken possible lateral dentine ridge; snr, subnasal ridge; soc, supraorbital sensory canal; t, tooth; TP, tooth-plate.
